# Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui Production Stack **Production-tested**: WordPress Auditor (https://wordpress-auditor.webfonts.workers.dev) **Last Updated**: 2026-01-20 **Versions**: tailwindcss@4.1.18, @tailwindcss/vite@4.1.18 **Status**: Production Ready ✅ --- ## Quick Start (Follow This Exact Order) ```bash # 1. Install dependencies pnpm add tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite pnpm add -D @types/node tw-animate-css pnpm dlx shadcn@latest init # 2. Delete v3 config if exists rm tailwind.config.ts # v4 doesn't use this file ``` **vite.config.ts**: ```typescript import { defineConfig } from 'vite' import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react' import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite' import path from 'path' export default defineConfig({ plugins: [react(), tailwindcss()], resolve: { alias: { '@': path.resolve(__dirname, './src') } } }) ``` **components.json**: ```json { "tailwind": { "config": "", // ← Empty for v4 "css": "src/index.css", "baseColor": "slate", "cssVariables": true } } ``` --- ## The Four-Step Architecture (MANDATORY) Skipping steps will break your theme. Follow exactly: ### Step 1: Define CSS Variables at Root ```css /* src/index.css */ @import "tailwindcss"; @import "tw-animate-css"; :root { --background: hsl(0 0% 100%); --foreground: hsl(222.2 84% 4.9%); --primary: hsl(221.2 83.2% 53.3%); /* ... all light mode colors */ } .dark { --background: hsl(222.2 84% 4.9%); --foreground: hsl(210 40% 98%); --primary: hsl(217.2 91.2% 59.8%); /* ... all dark mode colors */ } ``` **Critical**: Define at root level (NOT inside `@layer base`). Use `hsl()` wrapper. ### Step 2: Map Variables to Tailwind Utilities ```css @theme { --color-background: hsl(var(--background)); --color-foreground: hsl(var(--foreground)); --color-primary: hsl(var(--primary)); /* ... map ALL CSS variables */ } ``` **Why**: This generates utility classes (`bg-background`, `text-primary`) that reference the computed values at build time. The `hsl()` wrapper ensures compatibility with Tailwind’s color system. ### Step 3: Apply Base Styles ```css @layer base { body { background-color: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); } } ``` **Critical**: Reference variables directly. Never double-wrap: `hsl(var(--background))` is already handled in Step 2. ### Step 4: Result - Automatic Dark Mode ```tsx
{/* No dark: variants needed - theme switches automatically */}
``` --- ## Dark Mode Setup **1. Create ThemeProvider** (see `templates/theme-provider.tsx`) **2. Wrap App**: ```typescript // src/main.tsx import { ThemeProvider } from '@/components/theme-provider' ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render( ) ``` **3. Add Theme Toggle**: ```bash pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add dropdown-menu ``` See `reference/dark-mode.md` for ModeToggle component. --- ## Critical Rules ### ✅ Always Do: 1. Wrap colors with `hsl()` in `:root`/`.dark` 2. Use `@theme` (with `hsl()` wrapping) to map all CSS variables 3. Set `"tailwind.config": ""` in components.json 4. Delete `tailwind.config.ts` if exists 5. Use `@tailwindcss/vite` plugin (NOT PostCSS) ### ❌ Never Do: 1. Put `:root`/`.dark` inside `@layer base` (causes cascade issues) 2. Use `.dark { @theme { } }` pattern (v4 doesn't support nested @theme) 3. Use `hsl(var(--color))` inside `@layer base` – that’s double-wrapping 4. Use `tailwind.config.ts` for theme (v4 ignores it) 5. Use `@apply` directive (deprecated in v4) 6. Use `dark:` variants for semantic colors – they are auto-handled 7. Use `@apply` with `@layer base` or `@layer components` classes – use `@utility` instead --- ## Common Errors & Solutions ### 1. ❌ tw-animate-css Import Error **Error**: "Cannot find module 'tailwindcss-animate'" **Cause**: shadcn/ui deprecated `tailwindcss-animate` for v4. **Solution**: ```bash pnpm add -D tw-animate-css @import "tailwindcss"; @import "tw-animate-css"; ``` --- ### 2. ❌ Colors Not Working **Error**: `bg-primary` doesn't apply styles **Cause**: Missing or incorrect `@theme` mapping. You must wrap the variable with `hsl()` in the `@theme` block. **Solution**: ```css @theme { --color-background: hsl(var(--background)); --color-foreground: hsl(var(--foreground)); --color-primary: hsl(var(--primary)); } ``` If you omit the `hsl()` wrapper, Tailwind won’t treat the value as a color and utilities may not appear. --- ### 3. ❌ Dark Mode Not Switching **Error**: Theme stays light/dark **Cause**: The ThemeProvider controls the `.dark` class on ``. If you are toggling the class manually or using a different mechanism, it may conflict. **Solution**: 1. Create ThemeProvider (see `templates/theme-provider.tsx`) 2. Wrap app in `main.tsx` 3. Verify `.dark` class toggles on `` element If you are manually adding `dark` class via JavaScript, ensure it’s applied to `` (not ``). --- ### 4. ❌ Duplicate @layer base **Error**: "Duplicate @layer base" in console **Cause**: shadcn init adds `@layer base` – don't add another. **Solution**: ```css @import "tailwindcss"; :root { --background: hsl(0 0% 100%); } @theme { --color-background: hsl(var(--background)); } @layer base { body { background-color: var(--background); } } ``` --- ### 5. ❌ Build Fails with tailwind.config.ts **Error**: "Unexpected config file" **Cause**: v4 doesn't use `tailwind.config.ts`. **Solution**: ```bash rm tailwind.config.ts ``` --- ### 6. ❌ `@theme` Without `hsl()` Wrapper **Error**: `bg-primary` appears in editor autocomplete but has no visible effect **Cause**: When you use `@theme` (without inline), Tailwind compiles the value as-is. If the CSS variable contains `hsl(...)` string, Tailwind will not interpret it correctly without `hsl()` wrapper. **Solution**: Always wrap with `hsl()` in `@theme`: ```css @theme { --color-background: hsl(var(--background)); /* ✅ */ } ``` --- ## Quick Reference | Symptom | Cause | Fix | |---------|-------|-----| | `bg-primary` doesn't work | Missing or incorrect `@theme` mapping | Add `@theme` block with `hsl()` wrapper | | Colors all black/white | Double `hsl()` wrapping in base styles | Use `var(--color)` not `hsl(var(--color))` in `@layer base` | | Dark mode not switching | Missing ThemeProvider or wrong element class | Wrap app in ``, ensure `.dark` on `` | | Build fails | `tailwind.config.ts` exists | Delete file | | Animation errors | Using `tailwindcss-animate` | Install `tw-animate-css` | --- ## What's New in Tailwind v4 ### OKLCH Color Space Tailwind v4 uses OKLCH for the default palette. When defining custom colors, you can use OKLCH: ```css @theme { --color-brand: oklch(0.7 0.15 250); } ``` Browser support is excellent with automatic fallbacks. ### Built-in Features - Container Queries (built-in): `@container`, `@md:text-lg` - Line Clamp (built-in since v3.3): `line-clamp-3` ### Plugins Use `@plugin` directive: ```css @import "tailwindcss"; @plugin "@tailwindcss/typography"; @plugin "@tailwindcss/forms"; ``` --- ## Setup Checklist - [ ] `@tailwindcss/vite` installed - [ ] `vite.config.ts` uses `tailwindcss()` plugin - [ ] `components.json` has `"config": ""` - [ ] NO `tailwind.config.ts` exists - [ ] `src/index.css` follows 4-step pattern: - [ ] `:root`/`.dark` at root level - [ ] Colors wrapped with `hsl()` - [ ] `@theme` maps all variables with `hsl()` wrapper - [ ] `@layer base` uses unwrapped variables - [ ] ThemeProvider wraps app - [ ] Theme toggle works --- ## File Templates Available in `templates/` directory: - **index.css** - Complete CSS with all color variables - **components.json** - shadcn/ui v4 config - **vite.config.ts** - Vite + Tailwind plugin - **theme-provider.tsx** - Dark mode provider - **utils.ts** - `cn()` utility --- ## Migration from v3 Key changes: - Delete `tailwind.config.ts` - Use `@theme` in CSS (with `hsl()` wrapper for colors) - Replace `tailwindcss-animate` with `tw-animate-css` - Use `@plugin` instead of `require()` ### Default Element Styles Removed Headings, lists, and buttons lost default styles. Use `@tailwindcss/typography` or add base styles manually. ### PostCSS vs Vite Plugin For Vite projects, use `@tailwindcss/vite` plugin—it's simpler and avoids PostCSS conflicts. --- ## Reference Documentation - **architecture.md** - Deep dive into 4-step pattern - **dark-mode.md** - Complete dark mode implementation - **common-gotchas.md** - Troubleshooting guide - **migration-guide.md** - v3 → v4 migration --- **Last Updated**: 2026-01-20 **Skill Version**: 3.0.0 **Tailwind v4**: 4.1.18 (Latest) **Production**: WordPress Auditor (https://wordpress-auditor.webfonts.workers.dev)

edit_instructions.target_text:
### Dark Mode Setup

**1. Create ThemeProvider** (see `templates/theme-provider.tsx`)

**2. Wrap App**:
```typescript
// src/main.tsx
import { ThemeProvider } from '@/components/theme-provider'

ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="dark" storageKey="vite-ui-theme">
    <App />
  </ThemeProvider>
)
```

**3. Add Theme Toggle**:
```bash
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add dropdown-menu
```

See `reference/dark-mode.md` for ModeToggle component.

Dark mode is handled automatically via the `.dark` class on the `<html>` element. Define your theme toggle to add/remove that class directly. No additional provider or wrapper is needed.
